definition: a monster with an eagle head and lion body
description: A dark green bronze statue of a griffin stands on a stone pillar at the end of an old bridge wall at dusk. The creature has an eagle's head and huge spread feathered wings on a lion's body with a long tail, and one clawed foot is raised. A crow flies in and lands on the tip of its wing. A glowing street lamp stands beside it, wet cobblestones shine with puddles, and behind it a stone arch bridge crosses a misty river towards gothic towers under a stormy sky.
